items.event: PGA Tour: The RSM Classic (Sea Island), FedExCup Fall finale
items.line: Jesper Svensson (No. 135 in the FedExCup) opened with a 64 to lead and needs a finish of about solo 2nd or better to keep his card. Thorbjornsen, Higgo and Greyserman are close behind; Horschel started slowly in his fight for full status in 2027.

items.line: Three-time defending champions Italy (Cobolli, Musetti, Darderi) start against first-time qualifier South Korea. The other quarter-finals are Czechia v Canada, GB v Germany and Austria v Spain, and the final is on Nov 29.
